name: fortnox_account_activity
title: Account Activity Report
description: Voucher transactions touching one or more accounts, with per-account totals. Needs account_number, account_numbers or account_range. financial_year is Fortnox's sequential ID (1, 2, 3...), not a calendar year - call fortnox_list_financial_years first.

account_number.description: Single account number to filter by (1000-9999)

account_numbers.description: Multiple account numbers to filter by (max 20)

from.description: First account number in the range

to.description: Last account number in the range

account_range.description: Account number range (e.g., 3000-3999 for revenue accounts)

financial_year.description: Fortnox year ID (1,2,3...), not a calendar year.

include_summary.description: Include totals and summary per account (default true)

max_vouchers.description: Maximum vouchers to scan (10-500, default 500). Use date filtering for larger datasets.

name: fortnox_approve_supplier_invoice
title: Approve Supplier Invoice for Payment
description: Approve a supplier invoice so it can be paid. The invoice must not be cancelled, and payment approval has to be enabled on the company.

given_number.description: The supplier invoice given number to approve

name: fortnox_bookkeep_invoice
title: Bookkeep Fortnox Invoice
description: Bookkeep an invoice, creating the accounting entries. A booked invoice is locked - it cannot be edited or cancelled, only credited.

name: fortnox_cancel_invoice
title: Cancel Fortnox Invoice
description: Cancel an invoice. If it is already booked the cancellation creates reversal entries rather than removing it.

name: fortnox_cash_flow_forecast
title: Cash Flow Forecast
description: Generate cash flow forecast from unpaid receivables and payables. Shows expected inflows, outflows, net flow, and running balance grouped by week or month.

horizon_days.description: Number of days to forecast ahead (1-365, default: 90)

group_by.description: How to group the forecast: 'week' or 'month' (default 'week')

include_overdue.description: Include overdue receivables and payables in the forecast (default true)

starting_balance.description: Optional starting cash balance to use for projection

name: fortnox_cost_center_analysis
title: Cost Center Analysis
description:
[LIMITED] Analyze costs by cost center/department. Returns cost center list only.

For actual cost center data, use fortnox_account_activity with cost center filtering on vouchers.

cost_center.description: Limit to a single cost center code

account_range_from.description: First account number in the range (defaults to the tool's own range)

account_range_to.description: Last account number in the range (defaults to the tool's own range)

name: fortnox_create_account
title: Create Fortnox Account
description: Create an account in the chart of accounts. Account numbers are 1000-9999 and a description is required; fails if the number already exists.

active.description: Whether the account is active (default true)

cost_center_settings.description: Cost center settings for the account

name: fortnox_create_customer
title: Create Fortnox Customer
description: Create a customer. Only the name is required; the customer number is auto-generated when omitted.

name: fortnox_create_invoice
title: Create Fortnox Invoice
description: Create an invoice as a draft with at least one row. Bookkeep it afterwards with fortnox_bookkeep_invoice to post it. The customer number must exist.

name: fortnox_create_supplier
title: Create Fortnox Supplier
description: Create a supplier. Only the name is required; the supplier number is auto-generated when omitted.

name: fortnox_create_voucher
title: Create Fortnox Voucher
description: Create a manual voucher (journal entry). Debits must equal credits and at least two rows are required; the financial year must exist.

debit.description: Debit amount (use either debit or credit, not both)

credit.description: Credit amount (use either debit or credit, not both)

rows.description: Voucher rows (minimum 2 rows required, debit must equal credit)

cost_center.description: Default cost center for all rows

name: fortnox_credit_invoice
title: Credit Fortnox Invoice
description: Create a credit note for an invoice. Returns a new credit invoice referencing the original; the original stays as it is.

name: fortnox_customer_growth
title: Customer Growth Analytics
description: Growing and declining customers between two periods, with revenue change and counts of growing, declining and flat customers.

min_revenue.description: Only include customers above this revenue

name: fortnox_delete_account
title: Delete Fortnox Account
description: Delete an account from the chart of accounts. Cannot be undone, and only accounts without transactions can be removed.

name: fortnox_delete_customer
title: Delete Fortnox Customer
description: Delete a customer. Cannot be undone, and fails while the customer still has invoices or orders.

name: fortnox_delete_supplier
title: Delete Fortnox Supplier
description: Delete a supplier. Cannot be undone, and fails while the supplier still has supplier invoices - cancel or settle them first.

name: fortnox_expense_analysis
title: Expense Analysis
description:
[LIMITED] Analyze expenses by account class. Returns category structure only.

For actual expense data, use fortnox_account_activity with account_range={from: 4000, to: 8999}.

account_range_from.description: First account number in the range (defaults to the tool's own range)

account_range_to.description: Last account number in the range (defaults to the tool's own range)

name: fortnox_get_account
title: Get Fortnox Account
description: One account from the chart of accounts: description, VAT code, cost-centre and project settings, SRU code and balances.

name: fortnox_get_company_info
title: Get Fortnox Company Information
description: The company this token points at: name, organisation number, addresses and contact details. database_number identifies which company that is.

name: fortnox_get_customer
title: Get Fortnox Customer
description: One customer: contact details, addresses, payment terms, currency and VAT settings.

name: fortnox_get_invoice
title: Get Fortnox Invoice
description: One invoice with its line items, amounts and payment status.

document_number.description: The invoice document number to retrieve

name: fortnox_get_supplier
title: Get Fortnox Supplier
description: One supplier: contact details, addresses, bank details and payment terms.

name: fortnox_get_supplier_invoice
title: Get Fortnox Supplier Invoice
description: One supplier invoice with its line items, amounts and payment status. given_number is a string identifier, not a number.

given_number.description: The supplier invoice given number to retrieve

name: fortnox_get_voucher
title: Get Fortnox Voucher
description: One voucher with all of its accounting rows. financial_year is Fortnox's sequential ID (1, 2, 3...), not a calendar year.

financial_year.description: Fortnox year ID (1,2,3...), not a calendar year.

name: fortnox_gross_margin_trend
title: Gross Margin Trend Analytics

group_by.description: How to group the margin trend: 'month' or 'quarter' (default 'month')

cogs_accounts.description: Cost of goods sold account range (e.g., '4000-4999'). Default: 4000-4999

name: fortnox_invoice_summary
title: Invoice Summary Analytics
description: Invoice statistics for a period: count, total, average, min/max and outstanding balance. Add group_by to break it down by customer, month or status.

period.description: Named period, e.g. 'this_month'. If not specified, analyzes all invoices.

filter.description: Filter invoices by status before calculating summary

group_by.description: Group summary statistics by this dimension

include_details.description: Include list of individual invoices in the response (default false)

name: fortnox_list_accounts
title: List Fortnox Accounts
description: Chart of accounts, filterable by description or an account-number range; paginated.

from_account.description: Filter accounts from this account number

to_account.description: Filter accounts to this account number

name: fortnox_list_customers
title: List Fortnox Customers
description: Customers, filterable by status, name or customer number; paginated.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20)

name: fortnox_list_financial_years
title: List Financial Years
description: Financial years as Fortnox IDs (1, 2, 3...). Voucher and account-activity tools take those IDs, not calendar years - call this first.

name: fortnox_list_invoices
title: List Fortnox Invoices
description: Invoices, filterable by status, customer, date/period, due date and amount. fetch_all auto-paginates up to 10,000; min_amount/max_amount filter client-side after fetching.

min_amount.description: Filter invoices with total >= this amount (client-side filter, applied after fetching)

max_amount.description: Filter invoices with total <= this amount (client-side filter, applied after fetching)

name: fortnox_list_offers
title: List Fortnox Offers
description: List sales offers/quotes with filtering by status, customer, date range. Filter: cancelled, expired, ordercreated, ordernotcreated.

name: fortnox_list_orders
title: List Fortnox Orders
description: List sales orders with filtering by status, customer, date range. Filter: cancelled, expired, invoicecreated, invoicenotcreated.

name: fortnox_list_supplier_invoices
title: List Fortnox Supplier Invoices
description: Supplier invoices (accounts payable), filterable by status, supplier, date/period, due date and amount. fetch_all auto-paginates up to 10,000; min/max_amount filter client-side.

min_amount.description: Filter invoices with total >= this amount (client-side filter)

max_amount.description: Filter invoices with total <= this amount (client-side filter)

name: fortnox_list_suppliers
title: List Fortnox Suppliers
description: Suppliers, filterable by status or name; paginated.

name: fortnox_list_voucher_series
title: List Fortnox Voucher Series
description: Voucher series (A, B, ...) with their descriptions and whether manual entries are allowed. Needed before creating a voucher.

name: fortnox_list_vouchers
title: List Fortnox Vouchers
description: Vouchers (accounting entries), filterable by series, financial year and date. financial_year is Fortnox's sequential ID, not a calendar year.

financial_year.description: Fortnox year ID (1,2,3...), not a calendar year.

name: fortnox_order_pipeline
title: Order Pipeline Analytics
description: Order pipeline: pending, invoiced and cancelled orders with their value, plus a breakdown by customer, month or status.

group_by.description: Group pipeline statistics by this dimension

name: fortnox_payables_report
title: Accounts Payable Aging Report
description: Accounts-payable aging: unpaid supplier invoices grouped by age bucket and/or supplier, with balances and an optional per-invoice list.

min_amount.description: Only include invoices with balance >= this amount

group_by.description: How to group unpaid supplier invoices in the report (default 'both')

include_details.description: Include list of individual unpaid invoices (default true)

name: fortnox_period_comparison
title: Period Comparison Analytics
description: Compare revenue, invoice count, average invoice or new customers between two periods, as change and percentage change.

compare_to.description: Period to compare against (defaults to the previous one)

name: fortnox_product_performance
title: Product Performance Analytics
description: Top performers ranked by revenue, quantity or invoice count. Aggregates per customer, not per article.

top_n.description: Number of top items to return (default 10)

name: fortnox_project_profitability
title: Project Profitability Analytics
description:
[LIMITED] Analyze profitability by project. Returns project list only.

For actual project financials, use fortnox_account_activity with project filtering on vouchers.

project_number.description: Limit to a single project number

name: fortnox_sales_funnel
title: Sales Funnel Analytics
description: Offers to orders to invoices: counts, values and conversion rates at each stage.

name: fortnox_search_vouchers
title: Search Vouchers
description: Search voucher descriptions for text, optionally limited by series, financial year or dates. include_rows adds the accounting rows.

search_text.description: Text to search for in voucher descriptions (min 2 chars)

financial_year.description: Fortnox year ID (1,2,3...), not a calendar year.

case_sensitive.description: Whether search should be case-sensitive (default false)

include_rows.description: Include full voucher row details in results (default false)

name: fortnox_send_invoice_email
title: Send Fortnox Invoice by Email
description: Email the invoice to the address on the customer record. The company needs bank details on its transaction accounts or this fails before sending.

name: fortnox_top_customers
title: Top Customers Analytics
description: Rank customers by revenue, invoice count, unpaid amount or average invoice over a period; top_n limits the list.

period.description: Named period, e.g. 'this_month'. If not specified, analyzes all invoices.

top_n.description: Number of top customers to return (1-50, default 10)

include_details.description: Include invoice breakdown for each customer (default false)

name: fortnox_unpaid_report
title: Unpaid Invoices Report
description: Accounts-receivable aging: unpaid invoices bucketed by due date (1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+), grouped by customer and/or bucket.

min_amount.description: Only include invoices with balance >= this amount

group_by.description: How to group unpaid invoices in the report (default 'both')

include_details.description: Include list of individual unpaid invoices (default true)

name: fortnox_update_account
title: Update Fortnox Account
description: Update an account's description, VAT code, active flag, cost-centre/project settings or SRU code.

name: fortnox_update_customer
title: Update Fortnox Customer
description: Update a customer. Only the fields you pass change: name, email, address, payment terms, currency and VAT settings.

name: fortnox_update_invoice
title: Update Fortnox Invoice
description: Update a draft invoice. Only unbooked invoices can be edited, and rows replaces all existing rows.

rows.description: Updated invoice rows (replaces all existing rows)

name: fortnox_update_supplier
title: Update Fortnox Supplier
description: Update a supplier. Only the fields you pass change.

name: fortnox_yearly_comparison
title: Yearly Comparison Analytics
description: Compare revenue, invoice count, average invoice or customer count across 2-5 years, with year-over-year growth.

years.description: Number of years to compare (2-5, default: 3)
